props.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production environment prop atlas for a coastal HD-2D adventure game. Generate a single 2048x2048 square transparent PNG sprite sheet, precisely divided into a uniform 4 by 4 grid of 512x512 cells, NO drawn grid, transparent 32px empty margin in each cell. Each object isolated entirely inside its own cell, full silhouette, no overlap between cells. All props share the same straight-on front view from slightly above (see top surfaces, not isometric side view), warm hand-painted pixel-cluster illustration, restrained dark teal outlines, ochre wood, cream paper, muted teal metal, green leaves, modest texture detail matching 32x48 pixel characters when displayed small. Ambient neutral light only; no cast ground shadows, no room/background, no characters. In reading order the 16 cells contain: row1 solid wooden writing desk with four legs, teal filing cabinet, tall wood bookshelf filled with colorful unlabeled books, wooden chair; row2 vintage cream desktop printer, green banker desk lamp, neat stack of cream blank papers, several stacked closed books; row3 leafy green plant in terracotta pot, flowering green plant in cream pot, simple round clock with tick marks only no numerals, rectangular cork noticeboard with blank pinned papers; row4 large wooden window frame with transparent openings, wood door with small opaque teal glass pane, simple wooden market counter with folded cloth and unlabeled jars, small wooden rowboat. Every sprite has a clearly centered bottom contact point. Do not write any words, numbers, labels, signage, logos or watermark. Transparent means real alpha, not checkerboard painted into RGB. This is an original game art sheet, not a 3D render or photograph.
